title: Number of Islands
statement: Given an m × n 2D grid of characters where '1' represents land and '0' represents water, return the number of islands. An island is formed by connecting adjacent lands horizontally or vertically; diagonal connections do not count as part of the same island.

visibleExamples.explanation: All the land cells form a single connected island.
There are three islands: one in the top-left, one in the middle, and one in the bottom-right.
The grid contains no land, so there are no islands.

jsonFriendlyReason: All parameters and return type are JSON-representable primitives.
